runPolicy.cadence: daily at 10:43 UTC after the workflow is merged to main
runPolicy.heartbeat: The separate 15-minute heartbeat observes freshness and coverage; it must not fetch source sites.
runPolicy.requestLimit: 15 configured entry-point requests per run, maximum two per host, with robots.txt respected and at least 1.5 seconds between requests to one host.
runPolicy.retryPolicy: No automatic retry loop in this worker. A later scheduled run or a manually reviewed source-plan update handles failures.
runPolicy.retention: Only URLs, retrieval metadata, status codes, titles, and SHA-256 hashes are written. Response bodies and person-level data are not stored.

reviewGate.condition: A reviewer must approve a direct authoritative roster source before a downstream seat-registry or officeholder collector is proposed.
reviewGate.nonEvidenceRule: A successful hub retrieval is not evidence of an official, officeholder, affiliation, social account, portrait, vote, finance record, or score.
